Developer Building (hereinafter defined) has been constructed, the New Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the Developer Building situated on Block 1064, Lot 36, and construct a new building (which building, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “New Developer Building") upon the Developer Land; WHEREAS, the Developer desires to construct the New Developer Building with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) than would be permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land if the lot comprising the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS,Developer desires toutilize the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the 54 CF Land, the ACNY Land and the Developer Land into a combined zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") for the purpose of making available the excess floor area development rights for utilization in connection with the construction of theNew DeveloperBuilding; WHEREAS, there exist Floor Area Development Rights (hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to the 54 CF Land which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the 54 CF Building (the “54 CF Excess Floor Area Development Rights"), and the same may be utilized for future improvements, and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; the ACNY Landwhich are in excess of the FloorArea DevelopmentRights utilized by the ACNY Building (the“ACNY Excess Floor Area Development Rights"; together with the 54 CF Excess Floor Area Development Rights, the “Excess Floor Area Development Rights"), and the same may be utilized for future improvements, and are available for transfer pursuant to the ZoningResolution;
